import MilneLib.Sheaf.QuasicoherentBaseChange
import MilneLib.Sheaf.InvariantModuleBaseChange

/-!
# Quasicoherent sections on arbitrary affine open immersions

The affine comparison below uses the restriction adjunction directly. Its
adjoint is the actual restriction map on sections.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace MilneLib

variable {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (φ : R ⟶ S)
  [IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map φ)]

private noncomputable def restrictTildeComparison :
    ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom ⋙ tilde.functor S ≅
      tilde.functor R ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map φ) :=
  (conjugateIsoEquiv
    ((tilde.adjunction (R := R)).comp (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (Spec.map φ)))
    ((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ.hom).comp (tilde.adjunction (R := S)))).symm
      (gammaPushforwardNatIso φ)

/-- Restriction to any affine open immersion realizes scalar extension on
global sections of a quasicoherent sheaf. -/
noncomputable def quasicoherentAffineRestrictionSectionsIso
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (ModuleCat.extendScalars φ.hom).obj (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F) ≅
      moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj (F.restrict (Spec.map φ)) := by
  letI := isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_quasicoherent F
  exact tilde.isoTop _ ≪≫ moduleSpecΓFunctor.mapIso
    ((restrictTildeComparison φ).app (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F) ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map φ)).mapIso (asIso F.fromTildeΓ))

/-- The affine restriction comparison is adjoint to the actual section map
of the restriction unit. -/
theorem quasicoherentAffineRestrictionSectionsIso_homEquiv
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ.hom).homEquiv _ _
      (quasicoherentAffineRestrictionSectionsIso φ F).hom =
    moduleSpecΓFunctor.map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (Spec.map φ)).unit.app F) ≫
      (gammaPushforwardIso φ (F.restrict (Spec.map φ))).hom := by
  let M := moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F
  let A := Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (Spec.map φ)
  let B := ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ.hom
  let Q := moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := R)
  let P := moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := S)
  let E := ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ.hom
  let c := (restrictTildeComparison φ).hom.app M
  have hc := unit_conjugateEquiv_symm ((tilde.adjunction (R := R)).comp A)
    (B.comp (tilde.adjunction (R := S))) (gammaPushforwardNatIso φ).hom M
  change (tilde.isoTop M).hom ≫ Q.map (A.unit.app (tilde M)) ≫
      (gammaPushforwardIso φ ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map φ)).obj
        (tilde M))).hom =
    B.unit.app M ≫ E.map ((tilde.isoTop _).hom) ≫ E.map (P.map c) at hc
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  change B.unit.app M ≫ E.map
    ((tilde.isoTop _).hom ≫ P.map (c ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map φ)).map F.fromTildeΓ)) = _
  simp only [Functor.map_comp]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
  simp only [← Category.assoc] at hc
  rw [← hc]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  have hn := (gammaPushforwardNatIso φ).hom.naturality
    ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map φ)).map F.fromTildeΓ)
  change Q.map ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map φ)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map φ)).map F.fromTildeΓ)) ≫
      (gammaPushforwardIso φ (F.restrict (Spec.map φ))).hom =
    (gammaPushforwardIso φ ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map φ)).obj
      (tilde M))).hom ≫
      E.map (P.map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map φ)).map F.fromTildeΓ)) at hn
  rw [← hn, ← Category.assoc (Q.map (A.unit.app (tilde M)))]
  rw [← Q.map_comp]
  have hn' := A.unit.naturality F.fromTildeΓ
  change F.fromTildeΓ ≫ A.unit.app F = A.unit.app (tilde M) ≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map φ)).map
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map φ)).map F.fromTildeΓ) at hn'
  rw [← hn']
  rw [Q.map_comp, ← Category.assoc]
  have ht := (tilde.adjunction (R := R)).right_triangle_components F
  change (tilde.isoTop M).hom ≫ Q.map F.fromTildeΓ = 𝟙 M at ht
  rw [← Category.assoc, ht]
  change Q.map (A.unit.app F) ≫
      (gammaPushforwardIso φ (F.restrict (Spec.map φ))).hom = _
  rfl

/-- The actual restriction unit on affine sections, with scalar restriction
through the affine ring homomorphism. -/
noncomputable def affineRestrictionUnitMap (F : (Spec R).Modules) :
    moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F ⟶
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ.hom).obj
        (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj (F.restrict (Spec.map φ))) :=
  moduleSpecΓFunctor.map ((Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction (Spec.map φ)).unit.app F) ≫
    (gammaPushforwardIso φ (F.restrict (Spec.map φ))).hom

/-- On underlying sections the affine restriction unit is literal sheaf
restriction to the image of the affine open immersion. -/
theorem affineRestrictionUnitMap_apply (F : (Spec R).Modules)
    (m : moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F) :
    affineRestrictionUnitMap φ F m =
      F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : Spec.map φ ''ᵁ ⊤ ≤ ⊤)).op m := rfl

/-- The affine comparison sends `1 ⊗ m` to the actual restricted section. -/
theorem quasicoherentAffineRestrictionSectionsIso_one_tmul
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (m : moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F) :
    letI := φ.hom.toAlgebra
    (quasicoherentAffineRestrictionSectionsIso φ F).hom
        ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] m) = affineRestrictionUnitMap φ F m := by
  letI := φ.hom.toAlgebra
  have h := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    (quasicoherentAffineRestrictionSectionsIso_homEquiv φ F) m
  rw [ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj_homEquiv_apply] at h
  exact h

/-- The affine comparison is coefficient multiplication after actual
section restriction on every pure tensor. -/
theorem quasicoherentAffineRestrictionSectionsIso_tmul
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (s : S)
    (m : moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F) :
    letI := φ.hom.toAlgebra
    (quasicoherentAffineRestrictionSectionsIso φ F).hom
        (s ⊗ₜ[R] m) = s • affineRestrictionUnitMap φ F m := by
  letI := φ.hom.toAlgebra
  have he : s ⊗ₜ[R] m = s • ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] m) := by
    simp only [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [he, map_smul, quasicoherentAffineRestrictionSectionsIso_one_tmul]

/-- The ordinary tensor comparison obtained from the actual restriction map. -/
noncomputable def affineRestrictionBaseChangeMap
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    letI := φ.hom.toAlgebra
    S ⊗[R] moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F →ₗ[S]
      moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj (F.restrict (Spec.map φ)) := by
  letI := φ.hom.toAlgebra
  letI : Module R (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj (F.restrict (Spec.map φ))) :=
    Module.compHom _ φ.hom
  letI : IsScalarTower R S (moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj (F.restrict (Spec.map φ))) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _
  exact TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lift
    (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton S _ (affineRestrictionUnitMap φ F).hom)

@[simp]
theorem affineRestrictionBaseChangeMap_tmul
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (s : S)
    (m : moduleSpecΓFunctor.obj F) :
    letI := φ.hom.toAlgebra
    affineRestrictionBaseChangeMap φ F (s ⊗ₜ[R] m) = s • affineRestrictionUnitMap φ F m := rfl

/-- The ordinary tensor comparison is bijective on a quasicoherent affine
open restriction. -/
theorem affineRestrictionBaseChangeMap_bijective
    (F : (Spec R).Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    letI := φ.hom.toAlgebra
    Function.Bijective (affineRestrictionBaseChangeMap φ F) := by
  letI := φ.hom.toAlgebra
  let e := (quasicoherentAffineRestrictionSectionsIso φ F).toLinearEquiv
  have he : affineRestrictionBaseChangeMap φ F = e.toLinearMap := by
    ext x
    induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul s m =>
      exact (quasicoherentAffineRestrictionSectionsIso_tmul φ F s m).symm
    | add x y hx hy => simp [hx, hy]
  rw [he]
  exact e.bijective

end MilneLib
